sections.heading: Medha Dairy at Hotwar: Ranchi's Largest Hygienic Process Plant
paragraphs: The biggest user of hygienic stainless tube in Ranchi is a dairy. The Jharkhand State Cooperative Milk Producers' Federation, which markets under the Medha brand, has been managed by the National Dairy Development Board since April 2014. NDDB records four federation dairy plants, at Ranchi, Deoghar, Koderma and Latehar, with a combined installed capacity of 140 thousand litres a day, and a 50 tonne-a-day cattle feed plant at Hotwar in Ranchi. In 2019-20 the federation procured about 117.52 thousand kg of milk a day across 15 districts and marketed around 102.99 thousand litres a day, along with curd, paneer, ghee, lassi, peda and kheer mix.

On 6 June 2025 the Chief Minister of Jharkhand laid the foundation stone of a 20 tonne-a-day milk powder plant at Medha Dairy, Hotwar, to be built by NDDB. Until it runs, surplus milk collected in Jharkhand is sent to neighbouring states to be converted into skimmed milk powder, so the new plant brings evaporation, drying and the associated concentrate and CIP lines to Ranchi for the first time. NDDB has also been asked by the state to build and manage three further dairy plants on a turnkey basis.

sections.heading: The Pharma Park at Chanho and the Mega Food Park at Getalsud
paragraphs: Ranchi district also has two planned and built parks that call for hygienic tube. In September 2021 the Jharkhand Department of Industries said it was developing a pharma park and a food processing park in Chanho block, with 35 acres reserved for the pharma park and 55 plots: 30 for micro units, 14 for small, 7 for medium and 4 for large pharmaceutical producers. The chief minister directed that the park and the state's new pharma policy also provide plots and incentives for medical equipment manufacturers.

Jharkhand's first mega food park was inaugurated at Getalsud in Ranchi district in February 2016, on 51.50 acres and at a cost of Rs 114.73 crore, with multi-chamber cold storage, a dry warehouse, a vegetable dehydration line and a quality control laboratory for fruit and vegetable processing. Taken together with the dairy, these are the sites where an SF4 316L product line is specified in Ranchi, as against the heavy engineering the city is better known for through Heavy Engineering Corporation, established at Ranchi in 1958.

sections.heading: SF1 or SF4 for a Ranchi Dairy, Powder Plant or Food Line
paragraphs: Dairy is unforgiving of a rough bore. Milk fat and protein residues bake onto hot surfaces and give bacteria a foothold, so under ASME BPE surface designations the raw and pasteurised milk lines, cream and concentrate lines, powder-plant evaporator feed and the CIP return need an SF4 316L bore, mechanically polished then electropolished. Electropolishing removes the cold-worked surface left by drawing, lowers the Ra and leaves a chromium-rich passive film, which is why CIP cycles clear an electropolished line faster and why the line stays passive against the chlorinated and acid cleaning chemicals a dairy uses daily.

SF1 304L or 316L, mechanically polished only, is the sensible choice for chilled water, ice water, hot water sets and utility transfer lines that are cleaned but not held to product-contact standard. In a food park unit, the same logic puts SF4 316L on juice, pulp and product lines and SF1 on utilities. A pharma park plant adds purified water and WFI loops, which belong in SF4 316L, and where an API or Ayush process uses acidic or chloride-heavy streams, we quote 904L, supplied electropolished.

sections.heading: Documents for Ranchi Dairy Engineers and Food Auditors
paragraphs: A dairy or food plant working to FSSAI and its buyers' audits needs traceable material records. Each heat we supply carries an EN 10204 3.1 certificate traced to its heat number, with chemical analysis from a NABL-accredited laboratory. Every length is PMI tested before dispatch, and each electropolished lot comes with our internal Ra report so the finish can be filed against the line list. Our quality system is certified to ISO 9001:2015.

We supply ASTM A270 sanitary tube, ASTM A269 seamless and A249 welded tube, and ASTM A312 pipe in 304, 304L, 316 and 316L. If NDDB's turnkey specification or your consultant's inspection plan calls for additional tests, witness points or a particular marking format, send it with the enquiry and the quotation will reflect it.

sections.heading: Sending a Ranchi RFQ
paragraphs: A complete enquiry gets a quotation within 24 hours. For dairy, milk powder, food park or pharma park work in Ranchi district, include:
bullets: The plant and the line: raw or pasteurised milk, concentrate or evaporator feed, CIP, a fruit and vegetable product line, or a purified water loop, and whether you are the plant, a turnkey contractor or an equipment builder.
Grade and finish per line: SF4 316L for product contact and CIP, SF1 304L or 316L for utilities, 904L electropolished for aggressive chemistry.
Tube or pipe OD, wall, length and quantity, with the standard: ASTM A270, A269, A249 or A312.
Inspection or audit documentation required, and the delivery point, whether Hotwar, Getalsud, Chanho or elsewhere in Ranchi.

sections.heading: Supplying Ranchi and the Jharkhand Plateau
paragraphs: Electropolished pipes and tubes for Ranchi are dispatched by road from our Mumbai base at Shop No. 05, 113/117, Dr. MG Mahimtura Marg, 3rd Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004, each length capped and marked with its heat number. The quotation states the dispatch date and transit to your plant in writing.
